description: This file contains automated tests written in Python using the pytest framework. The tests focus on network operations such as downloading files with various parameters (chunk sizes, delays, number of files) over different HTTP protocols (HTTP/1.1, h2, h3). It includes setup fixtures, test functions, and utility methods for analyzing download performance metrics.

classes.name: TestStuttered
classes.description: A test class containing multiple pytest test methods for measuring download performance over various protocols and configurations.

methods.name: _class_scope(self, env, httpd, nghttpx)
methods.description: Fixture that sets up the environment for the class, starting nghttpx if HTTP/3 is supported, and reloading the httpd server.

methods.name: test_04_01_download_1(self, env: Env, httpd, nghttpx, repeat, proto)
methods.description: Test downloading a single file with specific chunking and delay, verifying response and status.

methods.name: test_04_02_100_100_10(self, env: Env, httpd, nghttpx, repeat, proto)
methods.description: Test downloading 50 files in 100 chunks with 10ms delay, warming up connection limits, checking total responses and response times.

methods.name: test_04_03_1000_10_1(self, env: Env, httpd, nghttpx, repeat, proto)
methods.description: Test downloading 50 files in 1000 chunks with 100us delay, similar warmup and check.

methods.name: test_04_04_1000_10_1(self, env: Env, httpd, nghttpx, repeat, proto)
methods.description: Test downloading 50 files in 10000 chunks with 50us delay, warmup, and performance metrics.

methods.name: Tuple[float,int,float,int,float] stats_spread(self, stats: List[Dict], key: str)
methods.description: Utility method to compute average, minimum, maximum, and their indices from response time statistics.
